title: Jam and Buns
lines: Jan, Dan and Sal are on a rug.
Jan and Dan have buns and jam.
Sal has a tan pup. It naps.
Jan sets a bun on the rug.
It gets the bun. It runs to Sal.
"The pup has the bun!" said Jan.
Dan lets Jan have a bit of his bun.
Jan dips the bit in the jam.
The pup naps on the rug.
